meanings.name: sp_key_coffin_talk_req
meanings.summary: The key coffin's interact handler asks its main script to start Lilly's lid examination.

effects.set: sp5C_key_coffin leaves its wait: it locks the joypad, moves a sprite (Lilly going in) from the player to the coffin, applies BG change #3A, sets $013A and prints 'Lilly: Strange... There's a key fastened inside this coffin.'
effects.clear: The main script keeps waiting. The handler prints 'Will: The coffins are lined up...' while $6F is clear; with $6F set it prints the 'Isn't there a hole in the coffin?' dialog and sets this byte.

meanings.notes: Producer: the interact handler code_069094 (talk). Consumer: the main script of the same actor. The handler tests $6F at sp5C_key_coffin.asm:84, so the scene cannot start before Lilly has joined.

meanings.name: mu_rama_first_talk_done
meanings.summary: Rama's first conversation has happened; bit 1 of the low byte of eventFlags that the finale test compares with $FE.

effects.set: mu66_rama_spirits spawns the six spirit actors (parameters 0-5); Rama's talk prints 'Hear the words of spirits awakened.' instead of the introduction; the byte counts toward the low-byte test against $FE.
effects.clear: No spirits exist; talking to Rama prints 'I am Rama, King of Mu...' and sets the byte.

meanings.notes: The direct read at :89 loads the byte $0A00 (flags $00-$07), masks it with $00FF and compares it with $00FE; bits 1-7 are the scratch flags $01-$07 of this scene (this flag plus the six spirit flags) and bit 0 is scratch $00, which must be clear. No actor of scene $66 sets $00 (no scene_flag_init row in scene_66_actors; the player idle code only reads $00).

meanings.name: mu_lair_bomb_wire_chosen
meanings.summary: The player has answered the bomb's red-or-blue wire question; either answer sets it.

effects.set: The countdown actor (code_06A69E) dies at its next test, which stops the timer. After the vampires are dead mu67_bomb runs the defusal scene (lock, music #1B, sound #2C, dialog 'Will: The bomb has been defused...') and sets scratch $03. Erik's talk handler stops saying 'First, defuse the bomb!'.
effects.clear: The countdown keeps running; after the vampires are dead mu67_bomb animates frame #24 in a loop; Erik says 'First, defuse the bomb! Hurry! Hurry!'.

meanings.notes: Both wires lead to the same result: the handler sets the byte for answer 'Red one' (list entries 0 and 1, line 111) and for 'Blue one' (line 117). The interact handler is installed at spawn, so the byte can be set while the vampires are alive; the defusal scene waits until enemiesRemaining is 0.

meanings.name: sp_stone_coffin_talk_req
meanings.summary: The stone coffin's interact handler asks its main script to start Lilly's coffin examination.

effects.set: sp5C_stone_coffin leaves its wait, locks the joypad, moves a sprite (Lilly going in) to the coffin, applies BG change #3B, sets $013B and calls GiveItem #11 (Purification Stone).
effects.clear: The main script waits. The handler prints 'Will: The coffins are lined up...' while $6F is clear and sets the byte after the 'hole in the coffin' dialog when $6F is set.

meanings.notes: When GiveItem fails (inventory full) or music is playing, the main script clears the byte and $013B again (:115 and :116) and waits for the next talk, so the coffin can be opened again.

meanings.name: mu_prayer_spirits_release_req
meanings.summary: The prayer-room show has printed 'The Sun god... Rama... The ocean holds a power...': every helper sprite of the show may leave.

effects.set: The ten helper sprites (code_069C14 and code_069BDA) leave their loops: after #1E ticks of flicker they die.
effects.clear: The helper sprites keep animating (frame loop on :145 and :163 tests).

meanings.notes: Set once per show: line 56 by the west branch (flag $7B), line 112 by the east branch (flag $7E).

meanings.name: mu_rama_spirit_a_talked
meanings.summary: The spirit with parameter 0 has told its story ('Once a single ray of light came from the sky...'); bit 2 of the finale test.

effects.set: Counts toward the low-byte test against $FE that unlocks Rama's finale.
effects.clear: The finale test fails.

meanings.notes: Parameter n of the six spirits (written to $24 right after each spawn, mu66_rama_spirits.asm:34-:49) selects the talk case: n sets scratch $02+n. Nothing reads the individual bits except the combined byte test.

meanings.name: mu_lair_fight_started
meanings.summary: The Vampire has finished the intro scene and the fight has begun (also used the same way in the rematch scene $F4).

effects.set: The Vampiress leaves her wait and joins the fight; the bomb's countdown actor starts the timer (digits from BCD $0140).
effects.clear: The Vampiress stays put (script parked at her wait); the countdown has not started.

meanings.notes: Producer: mu67_male_vampire after the intro (:155-:193), consumers: mu67_female_vampire and the bomb countdown (code_06A69E). The inventory also lists scene $F4 for these sites because btF4_neo_male_vampire jumps into the same code (code_0AF23E); the F4 actors were not read beyond that entry, so the F4 use of byte $02 is inferred from the shared code.

meanings.name: mu_rama_spirit_b_talked
meanings.summary: The spirit with parameter 1 has told its story ('One year after that our bodies began to change...'); bit 3 of the finale test.

effects.set: Counts toward the $FE test of Rama's finale.
effects.clear: The finale test fails.

meanings.notes: Same pattern as mu_rama_spirit_a_talked.

meanings.name: mu_rama_spirit_c_talked

effects.set: Counts toward the $FE test of Rama's finale.
effects.clear: The finale test fails.

effects.set: mu67_erik leaves its wait, sets actor flag $2000 and waits for $88 before it frees himself.

meanings.notes: Producer: mu67_neil right after it locks the joypad ($FFFC) and waits #1D ticks; consumer: mu67_erik.

meanings.name: mu_rama_spirit_d_talked

effects.set: Counts toward the $FE test of Rama's finale.

effects.set: mu67_kara leaves its wait and switches to frame #1C.
effects.clear: Kara keeps frame #1B.

meanings.notes: Producer: the Lilly sprite actor e_mu67_lily (spawned by mu67_neil); consumer: mu67_kara.

meanings.name: mu_rama_spirit_e_talked

effects.set: Counts toward the $FE test of Rama's finale.

meanings.name: mu_lair_neil_remark_done
meanings.summary: Neil has said 'Well, Will seems to have really grown up.' - the reunion dialog is finished.

effects.set: mu67_erik walks out of his cell (frame sequence from #0E/#11/#10 to #0B); mu67_kara waits #3B ticks, talks ('It doesn't matter! Let's think about how to leave Mu!') and queues the map change to scene $68.

effects.clear: The finale test fails.

meanings.notes: Same pattern as mu_rama_spirit_a_talked.

effects.clear: It waits #1D ticks, prints the narration and sets the flag.

meanings.name: sp_lilly_pocket_scene_done
meanings.summary: Lilly has met Will in the palace rooms and moved into his pocket ('I'll borrow Will's pocket for a while.').

effects.clear: sp5B_lily waits for the player to come near (BranchIfPlayerNear #02), then locks the joypad and runs the introduction; the coffins print only 'Will: The coffins are lined up...'; sp5D_fountain dies at spawn.

meanings.notes: Set at the end of the Lilly scene (scene $5B) after Lilly's two lines about Erik's transparent body and the pocket. Name from the dialog 'I'll borrow Will's pocket for a while' (dialogstring_06882D). Later 'Lilly speaks from his pocket' dialogs in Mu rely on the same state, but no Mu actor tests this flag.

meanings.name: sp_fountain_purified_done
meanings.summary: The Purification Stone has purified the demon fountain: the demons are people again, the vampires' victims are freed and the palace changes.

effects.set: Scene $5A: the villagers spawn (sp5A_villagers), the Phantom Ribber and the strange voice vanish, scene_meta loads the Freejia sprite set. Scene $5B: the four party-member spirits (Kara, Erik, Lance, Neil) vanish. Scene $5C: the villagers spawn, the slippers and ceiling skuddles die at spawn and scene_meta loads the Freejia sprites instead of the Mu enemy set. Scene $5D: sp5D_fountain dies and the fountain palette steps #1A instead of #25.
effects.clear: The demons (Phantom Ribber, slippers, skuddles) and the four trapped party members exist; the villagers do not; scene $5A and $5C use the enemy sprite set.

meanings.notes: Never cleared. The slipper test runs only in scene $5C and the skuddle test only in scenes $5C and $5D (they check sceneCurrent first), so the same actors in the Mu scenes are not affected. Villagers' placement: scene_5A_actors rows $07-$0E and scene_5C_actors rows $05-$0A. Set by sp5D_fountain at the end of the cutscene right after $0F is cleared and before it clears the fountain's solid tile (ClearSolidAbs (0D,0F)).
